doctor.summary: One-call diagnostics: Node version, skill install path,

list.summary: List open pages (shows unique target prefixes)

nav.summary: Navigate to URL and wait for load completion

perceive.summary: Full page perception with @ref indices + coordinates

text.summary: Clean visible text — optional CSS selector to scope

click.summary: Click by CSS selector, @ref, or accessible name

fill.summary: Clear field and type text (for form filling)

press.summary: Press key (Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, Space, Arrow*)

select.summary: Select an option in a <select> element by value

scroll.summary: Scroll page (down/up/left/right or x,y offset; default 500px; to top/bottom for the window document or nested overflow)

inject.summary: Live CSS/JS injection with tracking and removal

cascade.summary: CSS origin tracing — shows which rules apply, source file + line

dismiss-modal.summary: Close common dialog/modal patterns safely (close button, then Escape) —

elshot.summary: Element screenshot: captures element by CSS selector or @ref

spawn-debug-browser.synopsis: spawn-debug-browser [browser] [--port N] [--url URL] [--profile-dir DIR] [--exe PATH] [--format json]
spawn-debug-browser.summary: Launch an isolated debug profile (browser: edge|chrome|brave; default edge, port 9222).

stop.summary: Stop daemon(s) and report stopped targets, remaining sessions, or explicit no-op
